summary: ALTR CAME BACK, BUT LATE, AND MOSTLY BACKLOG. After last window's one-message week, the team sent 17 messages this window (Fred 10, Melissa 2, Mayson 2, Stephski 2, Derrek 1) and the client sent 11, up from 3. She is not withdrawing. She answered within seconds when Fred showed up, priced a new custom herself, and on 9/30 asked for more DMCA work ('I have a lot of new leaks, may we work on this?'). Asking for more service is the opposite of a churn signal. THE 9/22 MESSAGES WAITED ABOUT 3 DAYS. The first ALTR reply after her 11:56 messages on 9/22 came at 12:36 on 9/25 (Melissa's leak broadcast), then Fred at 12:59, about 73 hours. None of her three 9/22 threads was explicitly closed. Nobody confirmed the chatters were told she is home. Fred never acknowledged her VIP DEE instruction ('keep coming up with excuses'). The call is still not held. LEAK REPORT RESUMED UNDER A NEW OWNER. Melissa posted the weekly leak-removal update on 9/25 after a 17-day gap (Michelle's last was 9/8). The client thanked it on 9/30 and immediately asked for more takedowns. Derrek replied with one word, 'Yep', and nobody had followed up with how to send links or when by window close (14h). Michelle has now been silent 22 days and the handover was never explained to the client. NEW FAN MONEY SURFACED: on 9/25 Fred brought up 'one of the old lives', a fan who bought on 21/07/2026 ($9,000 VIP run plus a $500 tip for the live). This live was in none of our tracking. She had to ask 'Hi from when?', 'When did he purchase it' and 'how much did he pay', which is the same untracked-fan-payment pattern again. She agreed to do it and asked for Tuesday evening (9/29). Fred said 'Will keep you updated!' and then went silent for 5 days 20 hours. Tuesday passed with no update. FOURTH STRAIGHT SALE WITH APPROVAL + PRICE FIRST: Fred asked before selling a dirty-talk custom, she set $600. That streak is now real. PAYMENTS: the Sept 15-30 invoice went out on schedule on 10/1 (7-day terms, due ~10/8) but WITHOUT the pre-invoice OF-withdrawal reminder that produced the 4h36m payment last cycle. It was not paid by window close (~18h). The Aug 15-31 invoice (due ~9/8) is now 24 days past due and still has never been reconciled. Receipt confirmations are ungiven for a fifth cycle. Jason's $1,000 (87 days) and Manuel's $600 (133 days) passed a THIRD consecutive window with zero mentions. CHURN WATCH: no exit signals. No asks for exports, logins or data, no mention of other agencies or doing it herself, no fast-pay-with-zero-asks. Mild watch items: two 'my bad I just saw this' delays in a row (she checks the chat less often), and at window close she had not answered Mayson's 10/1 call ping or Melissa's 9/28 platform intake form.

health.rationale: 44, UP 8 from 36 (history 58, 46, 42, 40, 42, 45, 48, 36, 44). Up because the silence ended and the client is plainly still engaged. (1) ALTR output went from 1 message to 17, and Fred was fast on 9/26: her questions were answered within seconds to two minutes. (2) The leak report resumed (Melissa, 9/25) after 17 days and she thanked it. (3) Approval and price were sought before a sale for the fourth consecutive time ($600 custom). (4) The invoice went out on time with no sixth account-detail change. (5) She is asking for MORE work (new leaks), and her message count rose from 3 to 11. No churn signals. NOT HIGHER because: (a) her 9/22 messages waited about 73 hours, and none of the three threads was explicitly closed; (b) Fred's 'Will keep you updated!' on the Tuesday-evening live went unfulfilled for nearly 6 days; (c) a previously unknown paid live ($500 tip, bought 7/21) surfaced, so the Notion/fan-payment tracking is still incomplete; (d) the check-in call is still unheld 35 days after she agreed to it; (e) the pre-invoice withdrawal reminder was skipped, the Aug 15-31 invoice is 24 days past due and unreconciled, and receipts are five cycles unconfirmed; (f) $1,600 of held fan money (Jason, Manuel) went a third window unmentioned; (g) Derrek's reply to her new-leaks ask was one word with no next step; (h) Michelle (22 days) and Mica (15 days) were silent, the 9/10 IG question is 22 days unanswered, and every older overdue commitment aged another week. CHURN: none of the four exit signals seen. Payment is not fast and she is asking for things, not going quiet.
